title: deck storyboard
description: THE content source of truth. Every text field here is verbatim: the renderer may re-wrap a line, but nothing may summarise, rephrase, truncate or invent. Layout line breaks are expressed in `line_breaks_after`, never by editing the text.

notes.description: Free notes for the author. Not rendered, not part of the content digest.

slides.description: Explicit order. The array order IS the slide order and is part of the agenda digest.

id.description: Stable slide id. Referenced by assets, approvals and lint findings, so renaming one is a content change.

page_type.description: One of the implemented page types. Names from the design kit that deck has not implemented parse here and are then refused BY NAME, never silently substituted.

purpose.description: What this slide is FOR, in the author's words. Feeds the illustration prompt, so it must describe intent rather than restate the title.

section_label.description: The eyebrow above the title. null means intentionally absent.

subtitle.description: null means an INTENTIONALLY ABSENT subtitle and must never be back-filled. The content digest covers it, so adding one later invalidates content approval.

line_breaks_after.description: Layout line breaks, kept separate from the text itself so the words stay one verbatim string. Values are character offsets into the named field at which a hard break is placed.

body.description: Body content blocks. Which blocks a page type accepts is checked by deck validate, not by this schema.

footer.description: The footer banner. Used only when the source has a corresponding conclusion; deck never writes one.

active.description: 1-based index of the current item. Only that item is dark; the rest use the theme's inactive grey, which is a DECLARED contrast exception.

variant.description: A declared layout variant. The repetition rule compares slides only within the same (page_type, variant) bucket, so a legitimately different page is expressible without disabling the rule.

source_refs.description: Where this slide's content came from, as paths under sources/ or free citations.

cards.description: standard-3col takes up to three cards. More than three is refused rather than reflowed into a layout the theme has not been measured for.

icon.description: An icon-circle fill role from the theme. `teal` and `orange` are the reference deck's saturated pair; `blue`, `peach` and `mint` are its pale variants. The circle is CSS, so it carries no raster and no text.

slot.description: An illustration slot. Slot images MUST contain no text: HTML/CSS renders every word on the slide, which is what keeps a page-number change from forcing a re-render of 23 rasters.

brief.description: What the illustration must depict. Changing this materially is what re-requests the image; moving or resizing the container is not.

reuse_unchanged.description: A real photo, logo, product screen or QR code. Never regenerated, never recoloured, never cropped in a way that loses content. deck emits no generation prompt for these.

decorative.description: Declares that this slot may be overlapped by foreground content - a watercolour wash under a heading. Only declared overlap is allowed by the collision rule.

comparison.description: TWO OR MORE OPTIONS, COMPARED ON THE SAME AXES. `axes` names the attributes once; every column supplies one cell per axis, in the same order, so corresponding rows sit at the same height across columns - which is the whole reason this is not a table of free-form rows. The design kit: 左右で項目・尺度・ラベル位置を対応させる.

axes.description: The comparison axes, in display order. One row per axis.

columns.description: The options being compared. Two to four: beyond that the rows stop being readable side by side and the content is a table.

caption.description: A short second line under the label.

cells.description: One cell per axis, in the same order as `axes`. deck refuses a column whose length differs: a comparison with a missing cell silently misaligns every row below it.

emphasis.description: Marks this column as the recommendation. deck NEVER sets this itself - a verdict is the author's, and inventing one is exactly what the content gates exist to prevent.

process.description: ORDERED STEPS WITH DIRECTION. The array order IS the order, and it is drawn with numbers and forward arrows. The design kit: 番号と矢印で順序を明確にする。複数工程があっても矢印の方向を誤らない. A step may contain several items; they are drawn inside the step, never as extra steps.

steps.description: Two to five. One step is not a process; beyond five the arrows are thinner than the words.

label.description: The stage's own name, e.g. フェーズ0. The step NUMBER is drawn by deck from the array position and must not be written into the text.

items.description: What happens in this step. A stage with several items keeps them inside the step.

direction.description: horizontal reads left to right; vertical reads top to bottom. The arrows follow it, and deck will not draw an arrow against the declared direction.

ecosystem.description: WHO DOES WHAT, AND WHAT CONNECTS TO WHAT. Either a hub with periphery, or an upper layer of functions over a lower shared base. The design kit: 中心と周辺、または上段の機能と下段の基盤で関係を整理。ラベルを読める位置に置く. Every label is drawn in its own box; nothing is ever placed on a connector.

centre.description: The hub. Required when layout is hub.

nodes.description: The periphery, for a hub. Up to six: beyond that the connectors cross and the kit forbids crossing.

direction.description: Which way the arrow runs between the hub and this node. The start and the end of an arrow are meaning, not decoration.

layers.description: For `layers`: the upper function layers and the shared base, top to bottom. The LAST layer is drawn as the base.

items.description: The things that sit in this layer, drawn side by side inside it.

timeline.description: DATED OR SEQUENCED EVENTS ALONG AN AXIS. The design kit: 日時と項目を順に配置。同じ時期の出来事はまとめても、時間関係を変えない. The array order is the time order and deck never re-sorts it: `when` is the author's own wording - 来週火曜 is a legitimate value - and sorting free text would reorder the facts.

when.description: Verbatim as the source wrote it.

items.description: Several things at the same time are grouped inside one entry, which is what keeps the time relationship true.

emphasis.description: The entry the slide is about. The author's call, never deck's.
